text:
sarah: Quick heads-up — QBR prep item: we need a partner-health snapshot for the NexusHW co-launch and a proposal to shift partner credits toward marketplace GTM. Can folks take ownership of the audit + cost impact? :eyes:
raj: I can run usage/lead metrics for NexusHW partners this week. ETA EOD Thu. Will need the partner list and any recent success stories.
nana: @raj sending partner list now — include attach: https://redwood.internal/sheets/nexushw-partners (view-only).
lina: For credit shift, what constraints do we have from finance/contracting? Any locked commitments?
mike: No hard lock except two enterprise pilots with custom terms — those are flagged in the sheet. Finance said up to 60k can be reallocated if we keep runway for pilots.
raj: Quick note: early reseller leads are ~+18% QoQ but marketplace conversion lags. I’ll add conversion cohort breakdown to the sheet.
sarah: Goal: decide at Monday sync whether to propose a 30% credit shift from co-marketing pool -> marketplace listing credits. Need impact calc + a one-sentence customer-facing rationale.
nana: Draft calc in sheet tab "shift-scenarios". Example line: ```scenario: 30pct_shift, credits_moved: 45_000, est_new_revs: 72_000, payback: 1.6x```
lina: If we land 30% we must adjust the QBR scorecard weights: marketplace activation + deal pipeline. I can draft the scorecard delta.
raj: Two asks for my audit: (1) confirm partner enablement content was published (yes/no), (2) list top-3 technical blockers reported. I’ll annotate in the sheet.
partnerships-bot: Reminder: QBR prep doc due by 2024-03-18 17:00 UTC. Upload to /drive/partnerships/qbrs/NexusHW/ when ready.
mike: Small ops ask — if we boost marketplace credits, make sure we have a fallback routing policy to avoid burst spend. Ops can add guardrails.
sarah: Thanks all. Action owners: @raj audit + metrics, @lina scorecard changes, @ana update shift scenarios + one-line rationale, @mike ops guardrail. If anyone cannot hit Thu EOD, shout now. :thumbsup:
nana: I’ll update shift-scenarios + add rationale draft by Wed noon.
lina: Will have scorecard delta by Thu morning.
raj: EOD Thu audit uploaded. Will ping here with highlights.
partnerships-bot: File uploaded: /drive/partnerships/qbrs/NexusHW/nexushw-qbr-packet-v1.pdf (uploaded by sarah)
sarah: Great — after audit we’ll run a 15-min sync Fri to finalize the recommendation. Calendar invite incoming. :calendar:
